It starts with random uniform initialization and uses adaptive differential evolution (current-to-best/1 vs rand/1) with one-to-one greedy selection. After each generation, if budget allows, up to 5 extra evaluations are performed around the best point with a step size of 0.05*(ub-lb)/sqrt(dim). Seed controls all randomness; budget is strictly respected.

        self.dim = dim
        self.seed = seed
        self.best_value = None
        self.best_x = None

        lb = func.bounds.lb
        ub = func.bounds.ub
        dim = self.dim
        budget = self.budget
        evals = 0
        popsize = min(budget, max(10, 5*dim))
        pop = lb + (ub - lb) * rng.rand(popsize, dim)
        pop_fitness = np.zeros(popsize)
        for i in range(popsize):
            pop_fitness[i] = func(pop[i])
            evals += 1
            if evals == 1 or pop_fitness[i] < self.best_value:
                self.best_value = pop_fitness[i]
                self.best_x = pop[i].copy()
                report_best(self.best_value, self.best_x)
        if evals >= budget:
            return self.best_value, self.best_x

        F2 = 0.9
        CR = 0.9
        stagnation_counter = 0
        max_stagnation = max(5, int(budget / (3 * popsize)))

        beta = 0.1
        epsilon = 1e-6

            num_attempts = np.zeros(2, dtype=int)

                if rng.rand() < p:

                    candidates = list(range(popsize))

                    r1, r2 = candidates[0], candidates[1]

                    candidates = list(range(popsize))

                    cov = np.cov(best_pop, rowvar=False)
                else:
                    cov = np.eye(dim) * 1e-6
                # Regularize if needed
                try:
                    L = np.linalg.cholesky(cov)
                except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                    cov += np.eye(dim) * 1e-6
                    L = np.linalg.cholesky(cov)
                # Scale inversely with dimension
                scale = 0.2 / dim * (ub - lb)
                new_pop = np.zeros((popsize, dim))
                new_fitness = np.zeros(popsize)
                # First point is the current best (already evaluated)
                new_pop[0] = self.best_x
                new_fitness[0] = self.best_value

                    sample = self.best_x + scale * (L @ rng.randn(dim))

                    new_fitness[i] = func(sample)

                        self.best_x = new_pop[i].copy()
